claim: CAI-only front, 50 of 50 E. coli K-12 proteins, cai_greedy baseline, DNA Design Suite meets or exceeds baseline on all 50.

degenerate_cases.explanation: No protein is excluded. aceB and thrA contain AGG, which has weight 0 in the 54 ribosomal CDS, so usage.cai is 0 while any counted AGG remains. DEP-SRCH-020 linearizes search on the sum of log-weights in that case. On this record both meet cai_greedy. The MFE comparison is not this claim.

reason: CAI-only. One axis, usage.cai, maximized. Same ribosomal-protein relative adaptiveness for every arm, including codons whose count in the 54 ribosomal CDS is 0. Arms: the native CDS, cai_greedy, and one DNA Design Suite design (budget fast, 4 generations, seed 7, no structure objective, no forbidden motif). Claimed only when the DNA Design Suite value is at least cai_greedy on every protein. The MFE comparison against LinearDesign or CDSfold is not this record.
